node.title: XR SL-2 high-window exclusion: selected band occupancy N_d <= 17n^2/25 at every prize-row high band-proper depth
node.statement: At each of the three prize rows, for every globally generic-branch received pair after the ratified strip order and every ceil(h/2)<=d<=h-2, the support-wise first-match selected occupancy N_d of depth-d joint-explanation pairs carrying at least two selected live slopes satisfies 25N_d<=17n^2. The exact remaining premise is xr_band_maximal_window_divisor_count (SL-2-RES), which counts only maximal exact-depth locators with L_P>=2 and retains small-scale mixed-class survivors. The proved window system and maximality fiber identity give a bijection with N_d. Raw affine divisors and a claimed joint codimension 2d are not valid substitutes. Together with the banked low-depth envelope and cascade cap this fits H_band=s_lo-16n^3. RowC is outside this node.
